sections.title: 2. Precomputed facts and reproduction
sections.text:
`facts/source-inventory.json` — all 1173 classlike declarations, native public/protected
member text, parents, source sha256, name-resolved references and code expressions.
`facts/summary.json`: 1117 package types, 56 product types; 772 non-Internal incl product;
21 manifests; 1362 cross references to 171 unique symbols; 36 model declarations
(27 package + 9 product, includes abstract BaseModel); 85 ApiError/ErrorDescriptor
construction sites. These are declarations/sites, not counts of methods or unique codes.
P03 exact list is 68 (not every public-by-usage cross symbol); residual baseline 159.
AST consumer map excludes dynamic string class references; configs/module metadata and
PHPDoc are mandatory extra inputs in production scanner and P04.2 review.

Reproduce from repository root:

```bash
scripts/php84 php plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P04-design/scripts/inventory.php > /tmp/corex-p04-inventory.json
cmp /tmp/corex-p04-inventory.json plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P04-design/facts/source-inventory.json
composer module-layout-gate
```

Initial cmp exit 0 and module-layout 1112/159/0new/0stale (R3=68,R5=91).
After execution source changes, old inventory is immutable provenance; produce a new
inventory in execution artifacts, do not overwrite design facts to match candidate.
`classification.tsv` includes every declaration and path digest; `public-by-usage-verdicts.tsv`
contains all 68 rows; `error-code-map.tsv` has all 85 sites, including dynamic entries.
Source facts indexed by names, not output truncated in chat. No producer bundle input points to `/tmp`.

sections.title: 3.1 P04.1 — explicit scanner ownership
sections.text:
Implement `CoreX\Attributes\Internal\SurfaceScanner` and immutable internal records in
`packages/core/src/Attributes/Internal/`; root CLI `scripts/php-api.php` and graph use it.
No new package/dependency: nikic/php-parser ^5.4 already core require-dev;
phpstan/phpdoc-parser 2.3.6 installed root closure; declare core require-dev `^2.3` explicitly and synchronize lock without upgrading unrelated packages. CLI is tooling only,
not production service provider boot dependency. Api/Spi classes have no parser dependency.

Algorithm in order:
1. Discover packages + products from composer paths/production autoload; validate one
owner per declared FQCN. Parse named class/interface/trait/enum and top-level functions;
anonymous types are implementation details; public functions must be internalized/replaced
with categorized class methods (class attribute contract has no function namespace loophole).
2. NameResolver handles aliases/group-use/relative/FQCN + imports; parse Api/Spi only
from actual CoreX attribute FQCN. Evaluate supported literal/enum-class constant args,
validate kind/since, reject missing/duplicated/conflicting annotations. Bootstrap three
attribute declarations self-marked; `since` accepts `1.0` or complete numeric SemVer,
no inferred attribute on inherited child declaration.
3. Resolve native and PHPDoc declarations, generics, list/shape/class-string/aliases/
nullable/union/intersection/@throws/inherited signatures. Track cycles and path to
bad reference; unknown syntax/member target gives diagnostic, never a successful skip.
Public/protected schema must keep promoted properties and enum backing types/values.
4. Validate declaration rule and recursively walk Api payload type graph; recognize
local subclasses of Eloquent/vendor Model via parents, not namespace name. Reject
Collection/LazyCollection/model/internal payloads, including nested generic and event
fields. Spi Call events use the same immutable payload prohibition. External library
control types on documented Laravel SPI are explicitly separated in manifest layer,
never taken as Api DTO. Property hooks/native types parsed under PHP8.4.
5. Collect all cross-owner static references and config/module class-string edges;
product consumers included. Internal exception only existing finite composition policy
(package-graph config); no broad test/composition bypass. Self package Internal calls
allowed only within same module by module-layout. Reject consumer extends/implements Api.
6. Serialize sorted symbols/members/defaults/type trees, UTF8 + final LF, no timestamp;
manifest generation and doc generation use same model. `--check` compares bytes;
`--write` only writes derived manifests/docs, cannot mutate annotations.

CLI contract: `--report --format=json` exit 0 for expected classification debt while
report contains diagnostics; malformed source/config always exit 2. `--strict` exit 1
for violations; `--check` exit 1 for stale manifests; clean exit 0. Report state must
never be described as strict GREEN. P04.1 adds CI report lane; P04.4 switches strict.
No production hard-coded approved inventory count: coverage tested on known planted types.
Manifest and graph consume source freshness in same run, no cached JSON trust loophole.

sections.title: 3.2 P04.2 — classification + DTO seams (frontier)
sections.text:
Follow D63 + per-type table, in this order: immutable public data closure; extension
interfaces; facade/driver helpers; concrete models and consuming bridges; R5 same-module
ports; remaining internalization. Preserve supported behavior, SQL scopes/idempotency,
configuration cache/Octane reset, secret handling, durable payload versions and operation
profile derivation. For each changed record bind old/new FQCN + all consumers + reason.
Final `classification-result.tsv` has exactly one verdict for each original package type,
plus newly introduced DTO/ports, declaration sha256 and no unresolved status. New public
surface needs actual consumer intent, no Api/Spi blanket annotation of old Support.

Task read port `TaskReader::find(string $id): ?TaskView`, Stage/Project counterparts only
where consumers need them. View fields: ids plus fields read at current call sites;
no arbitrary Eloquent toArray/attributes serialization. Existing draft/reference/value
objects reused. `TaskCompletionCandidate` carries task id, previous/current TaskStatus,
changed bool, request key/version inputs; `TaskCompletionCapture::capture(candidate): void`
is Spi Implement. Task package calls all registered capture contributors in save transaction;
no framework model crosses seam. Existing workflow tests must still prove one receipt,
rollback on capture exception, ignored unchanged status, disabled flag and no missing
WorkflowBinding side effect. Generic API events carry immutable snapshots/ids.

`Config` consumers inject current CoreOptions from existing binding; static core holder
moves Config/Internal only for own module bridge. This is bounded public dependency
repair; new compiled configuration/lifecycle/ports of P05 are excluded. CompiledRegistry
remains Spi data projected from ModuleRegistry, not a second mutable runtime catalogue.
Cross-module R5 fixes use explicit public ports, not generic annotation exceptions.

Classifying/moving more than 20 paths triggers scratch-worktree replay of transformation:
use existing P02/P03 AST/literal tools with a new final map, then full Validation in
scratch, then candidate equality for mapped paths in owning checkout. DTO logic is
reviewed separately; equality only proves replay determinism, not semantic equivalence.
No dry run executes protected external actions. Internal naming/layout fixed by D57;
any target collision is resolved before map sealing, not by class_alias.

sections.title: 3.3 P04.3 — error registry (frontier)
sections.text:
Retain category, retryability, path/detail bounds. Core ErrorCode interface + readonly
ProblemDefinition live under Errors Contracts/Data; CompiledProblemRegistry Internal,
ProblemRegistry read port Api, DefinitionProvider Spi Implement, package ErrorCodes enum
and provider contribution declarations. Register declared package owner from composer
metadata, not enum-string authority; duplicate/foreign-prefix/URI collision all fail boot.
Registration frozen after boot; no per-request mutable error catalogue.

85-map replacements preserve site-specific category/status overrides and safe text;
wire code changes intentionally scoped. Backed enum case names PascalCase existing code
snake_case; exact wire `<slug>.<old-code>`. ErrorCode.value() method returns backed value.
New core codes cover unexpected failure and registry errors, package exceptions cover
existing surfaced failure meanings; no inferred human exception message in code.
StoredOperationOutcome restores via validated registry wire lookup and typed ErrorCode;
unknown code/corrupt stored outcome mapped safe internal error rather than silently
accepted. Queue/job serialization round-trip keeps stable string and reconstructs via
owner enum/registry; unsupported error codes fail closed. Error mapping does not invoke
external retry or change retry policy. Compile contribution tests boot isolated Testbench
with/without optional packages to prove kernel usefulness without Operations/Flex.

Typed factory/new ApiError literal gate uses same name resolver, checks named `code`/
`errorCode` as well as positional args, dynamic raw string rejected except explicit
ProblemRegistry validated lookup method. Constructor typechecker backs dynamic cases.
Existing literal-only ErrorContractTest rewritten to registry fixture/descriptor semantics
instead of retired without replacement. HTTP transport redesign stays P06.

sections.title: 3.4 P04.4 — strict cutover (implementation/high)
sections.text:
Input predecessor evidence: `artifacts/P04.2-execution/classification-result.tsv` and
`artifacts/P04.3-execution/error-registry.json`. These files are future-produced;
do not fabricate/bundle them at design. Implement the following fixed sequence:

| Step | Command/change | Expected / discrepancy |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `scripts/php84 php scripts/php-api.php --report --format=json` | no classification/leak/import diagnostics; otherwise return to owning producer repair |
| 2 | replace graph R4/R4b namespace checks by source scanner membership | all R1/R2/R3/R5 controls remain; `--strict` fails seeded bad symbols |
| 3 | remove `extra.corex.public-api` from all 21 manifests including product, retain other extra | graph reads typed membership; product sources consumer-only; composer validate + lock sync |
| 4 | retire `package-graph-undeclared-surface.json` only after zero uncovered symbols | its old debt cannot be converted into new baseline; existing fixtures updated to attributes |
| 5 | `scripts/php84 php scripts/php-api.php --write` | per-package php-api.json and reference docs derive from source; second write byte-identical |
| 6 | `scripts/php84 php scripts/php-api.php --strict --check` | exit 0; modify snapshot byte => exit 1; restore => exit 0 |
| 7 | add exact strict command CI + composer `php-api`; rewrite API policy/SemVer + package docs/changelogs | public promises describe supported layer; no namespace-list claims remain in active docs |
| 8 | Roave membership selection D64 + negative probes | removed Api, Spi Implement member addition fail; internal-only change passes; infrastructure error stays RED |
| 9 | all item acceptance + independent review | final strict, golden, architecture, ratchet, SQLite/PG/package stack green |

`docs/architecture/semver-policy.md` matrix: Api consumers (parameter names/nullability/
properties/enum/default semantics), Spi Implement producers (new required members,
protected hooks/construction), Spi Call extensions (call/declaration/subscription contract),
Internal no BC promise. `docs/reference/public-api.md` generated by scanner; public-docs
include this surface through existing docs claim gates. Attributes `since` is introduced
version, not proof package already released. `extra.corex.stability` remains separate.
Stable packages strict BC; experimental pre-1.0 D01 delta declared in changelog, infrastructure
RED cannot be report-only. Source-level API snapshots and behavior contracts both remain.

sections.title: 4. Golden delta runbook (P04.1 / P04.2 / P04.3)
sections.text:
1. Before mutation copy affected baseline/rename map/promoted fixtures to own execution
preimage, record sha256 + source commit. Read actual changes allowed by D63/D64.
2. Generate candidate layers in isolated checkout with `GOLDEN_UPDATE=1 scripts/php84
composer golden`; candidate output alone is not acceptance. Produce semantic diff JSON
by layer/symbol/code and match every changed record to classification or error map.
No change to routes baseline; changes to event payloads require DTO-specific tests.
3. Run affected tests + full Validation, then reviewer reads candidate semantic diff,
contract, tests and output. Any unrelated change remains a defect. <=2 review rounds.
4. Copy only approved changed layers to owning checkout (P04.1 — php-surface новых атрибутов/scanner; php-surface plus events for
P04.2 as applicable; php-surface/wire for P04.3); preserve routes bytes. Update dependent
promoted fixture keys/defaults and rename map for actual moves so projection has no stale
old target. Never hide new public methods as a mechanical rename.
5. Fresh `scripts/php84 composer golden` (no update env) passes all 4 layers; seeded
public method/code drift fails. Store preimage, candidate, approved semantic delta and
review. Old baselines remain recoverable from git/preimage. No automatic all-layer bless.

sections.title: 5. Failure playbook
sections.text:
| Signal | Classification / action |
|:--|:--|
| stale plan view/bundle | regenerate through Task owner once; never edit generated carrier by hand |
| source-map digest/target collision | owning map repair before rewrite, dry replay; retain original evidence |
| unsupported PHPDoc/native syntax | scanner diagnostic + smallest focused parser fixture; do not skip node |
| custom-fields/workflow/tenancy imports Internal | facade/DTO/port in actual owner; do not allow foreign Internal globally |
| module-layout residual | inspect exact 159 baseline keys; remove only repaired keys, add no new key |
| duplicate error prefix/code/type at boot | fail boot with configuration exception; owner contribution fix, not last-wins |
| Golden code/DTO RED | deliberate semantic diff and reviewed D64 flow; no rewrite solely to silence test |
| literal/dynamic code RED | typed enum or registry lookup; never change gate to ignore path |
| PG/test infrastructure | P01/P03 proven setup first; exact isolated _test DB preflight before mutable tests |
| unavailable PHP8.4 | resolve existing scripts/php84 host wrapper; no downgrade to PHP8.3 |
| real authority/external release boundary | stop that action, evidence + owner; P04 local work continues |

sections.title: 6. Assurance / self-check
sections.text:
P04.1/P04.2/P04.3 frontier/high/full because type graph, minimal public surface and
error failure semantics need independent judgement. P04.4 implementation/high/full:
branch choice fixed by D63/D64, ordered rollout above, predecessor rows and scanner
commands supply complete inventory. No arbitrary path count escalates routine fixes.
P04.4 has no new architecture choice and no need to rediscover namespace inventories;
review source delta, not assertions of total coverage. Public changes receive changelog.

Design self-check: 4 outcome items; Inputs bind this dossier/retrieval/examples + relevant
maps; Required Reads <=8; all producer paths declared by owning Deliverables; only first
ready item is dry bundle-rendered now. Future bundle materialization waits predecessor
artifacts. No execution states claimed GREEN. Phase finalize must lint and agree with
handoff Next=finish; finish then independent audit opens execution. Future P05–P09 backlog
remains undetailed under D24. No hosted CI/push included (D47).
